scripts.dev: npm run prepare:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @novel-tool/api" "npm run dev -w @novel-tool/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run prepare:packages && npm run dev -w @novel-tool/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run prepare:packages && npm run dev -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.build: npm run prepare:packages && npm run build:prepared
scripts.build:api: npm run prepare:packages && npm run build -w @novel-tool/api
scripts.build:web: npm run prepare:packages && npm run build -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.check: npm run prepare:packages && npm run check:prepared
scripts.check:api: npm run prepare:packages && npm run check -w @novel-tool/api
scripts.check:web: npm run prepare:packages && npm run check -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.test:regression: npm run prepare:packages && npm run test:regression:prepared
scripts.test:integration: npm run prepare:packages && npm run test:integration:prepared
scripts.test:contract: npm run prepare:packages && node scripts/run-test-files.mjs contract
